description: Use when an agent is about to buy, accept or list a Solana token. Input: mint. Output: JSON riskLevel and rule-based signals with evidence (mint or freeze authority not renounced, permanent delegate, transfer hook, transfer fee, default-frozen accounts, mutable metadata), top-10 holder concentration with owners. Curated issuer stablecoins are marked as expected controls. Not an audit. Example: ?mint=EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v Price: $0.009 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

mint.description: Token mint address on Solana mainnet (base58, 32 bytes). Bad input → 400, not a mint → 422 (not charged)

name: sol_token_risk
title: Solana token risk signals: live mint/freeze authority, permanent delegate, transfer fee/hook, holder concentration
